plain_description.what: Rebuilds the label-free tree on MMLU-Pro with two embedders (nomic and qwen3) on three fresh random train/evaluation splits that share no question text (6 builds, no calls). It compares how well each tree files questions into the right place.
plain_description.why: An earlier test (E1) found the nomic embedder files worse. This checks whether that loss is real or just luck of one split.
plain_description.information: A consistent loss larger than the split-to-split spread would make the embedder effect robust. Otherwise it stays specific to one split. Result: neither. Nomic filed worse on all 3 splits (the sign held), but the average loss is not larger than the spread between splits. That spread was inflated by one unusually coarse nomic build. The falsifier fired on the size of the effect, not its direction. E1 now reads "at this split only; not stable across 3 re-draws". One corpus and one recipe only.
